title: Guardians and Offenders: A Survey on Harmful Content Generation and Safety Mitigation of LLM

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review synthesizing studies that analyze LLM-generated letters of recommendation for male-coded language, evaluate gendered stylistic differences in scientific writing, and examine relationship decision-making prompts.

Literature review of studies demonstrating how models reinforce racial stereotypes through word associations, narrative structures, and representations of marginalized communities in AI-generated news.
Reviewing studies that evaluate LLM outputs in culturally specific contexts, such as humor generation that struggles with culturally offensive language involving minority groups.
Categorized and surveyed under identity-based harms, examining datasets and benchmarks that target systemic inequalities and hateful remarks based on religion.

Discussed within the taxonomy of biased content and reviewed via studies assessing LLM applications for transgender and non-binary individuals, including misgendering and toxic language in responses to gender disclosures.
